target.dynamic_runtime: Cloudflare Pages Functions or Advanced Mode Worker

compatibility_rule: A static-only upload is not a valid migration. Dynamic routes, webhook verification, engine proxy and durable state must be preserved before DNS cutover.

routes.expected: 200 JSON liveness with status DEGRADED_STATIC_PREVIEW; ready=false and production_ready=false; not full acceptance
200 JSON diagnostic with CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA when supplied; missing SHA fails deployment identity acceptance; production_ready=false
Read-only published product projection from public/catalog.json using dreamledger/products/v1
Read-only published offer projection from public/catalog.json using dreamledger/offers/v1
Current contract parity, held state preserved
Signature verification, idempotent processing, no raw secrets in logs

routes.purpose: Explicit Pages not-found document preventing default SPA fallback

routes.expected: 404 HTML containing the dedicated not-found marker, not the homepage

stateful_dependencies: Neon connectivity, write/read-back and transaction behavior
restore/export rollback and stable correlation IDs
cutover_gates: all listed routes tested against a preview deployment
expected status codes, headers and cache behavior verified
no secret or private endpoint exposed to browser
test-mode signed webhook duplicate replay proves idempotency
Neon SQL read/write/read-back and backup/restore proof passes
origin and dreamledger.org custom domain independently return expected responses
current main provider and data export retained until cutover acceptance
explicit approval before production DNS/domain or payment-path mutation
deployed GET /data/mtg-catalog.json is valid and confined to silo=mtg
each product with status=published in the deployed MTG catalogue has a detail_url returning 200 HTML with matching product identity
every published MTG deck claim_url is present, syntactically safe, and agrees with the user-visible detail-page claim control; held products remain non-purchasable

preview_implementation.read_only_catalogue: GET /api/products and /api/offers read published entries only from public/catalog.json
preview_implementation.not_found: Root public/404.html is required; smoke test probes a unique nonexistent path and expects 404 with Page not found marker.
preview_implementation.mtg_routes: Smoke test enumerates each published product from /data/mtg-catalog.json, requests its declared detail_url, checks identity and claim-action contract.
